declaration.what: advance widths, in em, of HWP's own HFT faces
declaration.how: Widths[code] x FontMatrix[0], read out of the Type 3 font objects Hancom Office's own PDF export emits for a face it cannot embed, grouped by the HFT face the paired HWPX runs declare (hh:font@type="HFT")
declaration.source: the ten reference PDFs under tests/corpus/forms/render/, exported by Hancom Office
declaration.does_not_contain: no glyph outlines, no CharProcs streams, no font program, no font file, no byte of any Hancom font
declaration.legal: black-box output of a public document pipeline. Nothing here opens, reads or decompiles a Hancom font file; the numbers are the export's own declared advances, which any reader of those public PDFs can read the same way.

verification.what: the declared /Widths against the pen distance between two aligned glyph origins, on unstretched lines with no hh:spacing, per singleton segment
verification.note: a singleton's pen distance runs to the NEXT glyph's origin, so it still carries any gap Hancom opens at a class boundary; the residual is an upper bound

declaration.hangul_fallback: a Hangul syllable this table does not cover is advanced by the declared cell; see the per-face hangul_em below
